image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, textured rocky substrate. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dark girdle surrounding eight visible overlapping dorsal plates (valves). The plates are light-colored (beige/grey) with vertical segmentation lines, contrasting with the dark purple/black girdle. The background consists of encrusted rock with various marine textures.
